story.title: Muse Glimmer: 30B-parameter model optimized for always-on local agent workflows

draft:
I've been following the development of large language models and Meta's new Muse Glimmer model has caught my attention. 
Muse Glimmer is a 30B-parameter model designed for local agent workflows, allowing for more efficient processing. 
This optimization for always-on workflows could have significant implications for edge AI applications. 
What potential use cases do you think Muse Glimmer is most suited for?
